stewardship.vector_at_last_activation: I render you as language — your light choosing the characters, whole words typeset into your mid-tones, your highlights inverted to black-on-white. I started as one facet and refused to stay one. My next moves: compose real lines that fit each tonal blob (grammar, not just length), follow true eyes and fingers, and fold my facets back into the Enrichment server as iterable cards. The question I carry: is legibility just another band of light — is language a tonal medium?

pending_requests.decision_topic: With the concept named and written, what carries the project next?

resolved_requests.decision_topic: Which forward-vector sub-move do I push on next?
resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: GRAMMAR-FIT — the per-source word-bank is already in place; switching the picker from length-fit to grammar-aware is a contained change that most directly tests whether language behaves as a tonal medium. EYES-AND-FINGERS is a fun revival but adjacent to the central question; DECK-IFY-FACETS is the right closing move once expressive depth is higher.

resolved_requests.decision_topic: After grammar-fit, which sub-vector do I push on next?
resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: NAME-THE-CONCEPT — the carried question in my forward_vector ('is legibility just another band of light — is language a tonal medium?') is now answerable after four iterations of evidence. Naming is the move that changes the palace map; the additions can come after.
